prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether fault is disputed, your insurance situation, and whether you want to go to trial or settle. I can help you find excellent lawyers, but here’s a practical way to choose one and next steps you should take now.

How to find the best lawyer for your case
- Use reputable lists and directories to find well-rated Houston attorneys: Super Lawyers (Texas), Best Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell (AV ratings), Avvo, and Google/Yelp reviews.  
- Check disciplinary history and standing with the State Bar of Texas.  
- Look for lawyers who focus on plaintiff personal injury and have substantial car-accident experience — preferably trial experience if your case might not settle.  
- Ask about their track record with cases like yours (settlement amounts and verdicts, not just marketing blurbs).  
- Prefer contingency-fee lawyers (no fee unless you recover) and clarify the percentage and who pays costs if you lose.  
- Choose someone you can communicate with easily and who will put your case value and medical needs first.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?  
- What similar cases have you settled or tried, and for how much?  
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney or junior staff)?  
- What is your fee structure and typical percentage? Any additional costs?  
- How will you handle medical liens and bills?  
- What timeline and outcome should I reasonably expect?

Immediate steps after a wreck (if not already done)
- Get medical attention and follow it — documented injuries are critical.  
- Report to police and get a copy of the crash report.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, injuries, scene; witness contact info; medical records.  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurance companies without your attorney.  
- Keep a record of expenses, missed work, and how the injury affects daily life.

If you want, I can:
- Search and return a short list (3–5) of highly rated Houston personal injury attorneys who handle car wrecks, with ratings and contact info, or  
- Recommend attorneys based on more details about your crash (zip code, injury severity, whether fault’s disputed, whether you want to sue an insurance company or a government entity).

Tell me how you’d like to proceed and a few details about your case if you want specific attorney referrals.
